chunks: As for what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn al-Rabīʿ, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the menstruating woman becomes pure before al-ʿAṣr, she performs al-Ẓuhr and al-ʿAṣr. But if she becomes pure at the end of the time of al-ʿAṣr, she performs al-ʿAṣr.

key_terms.الْعَصْرِ: the afternoon prayer and its prescribed time
key_terms.طَهُرَتِ: became pure from menstruation and able to resume ritual acts

ai.seo_question: What prayers must a menstruating woman make up if she becomes pure before or near al-ʿAṣr time?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the salat (prayer) obligations of a woman when her menstruation ends during the daytime prayer periods. If she becomes pure before al-ʿAṣr, both al-Ẓuhr and al-ʿAṣr are due; if purity occurs only at the end of al-ʿAṣr time, then only al-ʿAṣr is due.
